concept_details.name: Absorption
concept_details.definition: Heavy volume at a level without price continuation. One side is absorbing the other's aggression, often signaling exhaustion and impending reversal.

concept_details.name: Aggression
concept_details.definition: One side is actively and forcefully pushing price. Seen in large footprint bubbles, stacked imbalances, and CVD divergence.

concept_details.name: Aggressive
concept_details.definition: Concept extracted from Lesson01

concept_details.name: Auction
concept_details.definition: Concept extracted from Lesson01

concept_details.name: Balance
concept_details.definition: Market is rotating around fair value, accepting price within a defined range. ~70% of the time. Do NOT trade breakouts here.

concept_details.name: Break
concept_details.definition: Concept extracted from Lesson01

concept_details.name: Breakout
concept_details.definition: Price moves decisively beyond a key level (VAH, VAL, range high/low) with volume and aggression.

concept_details.name: CVD
concept_details.definition: Cumulative Volume Delta — the running total of delta. Shows which side has been in control over time. Trending CVD = sustained aggression.

concept_details.name: Candle
concept_details.definition: Concept extracted from Lesson03

concept_details.name: Chart_Detected
concept_details.definition: A trading chart region was identified in the video frame through contour analysis.

concept_details.name: Choppy_Structure
concept_details.definition: Chart structure is choppy with no clear directional bias.

concept_details.name: Close
concept_details.definition: Concept extracted from Lesson01

concept_details.name: Delta
concept_details.definition: The net difference between buying and selling pressure at each price level. Positive delta = buyers aggressive; negative = sellers aggressive.

concept_details.name: Direction
concept_details.definition: The prevailing price trajectory — up, down, or sideways. Fabio establishes directional bias before any setup.

concept_details.name: Displacement
concept_details.definition: A strong, impulsive move with little retracement. Indicates imbalance and institutional participation.

concept_details.name: Entry
concept_details.definition: The specific price and moment where a position is initiated. Must align with State + Level + Flow.

concept_details.name: Exhaustion
concept_details.definition: The aggressive side is running out of orders. Seen as delta divergence, shrinking volume on new highs/lows, and absorption.

concept_details.name: Exit
concept_details.definition: Closing a position, either at target, stop, or discretionary management point.

concept_details.name: Failed_Auction
concept_details.definition: Price tests a key level multiple times but fails to break through. Indicates absorption and often leads to a reversal or mean reversion.

concept_details.name: Footprint
concept_details.definition: The ATAS footprint chart showing bid/ask volume at each price level. Reveals microstructure: absorption, aggression, and imbalance.

concept_details.name: Footprint_Grid
concept_details.definition: Detected a footprint chart grid with approximately 468 cells.

concept_details.name: Gap
concept_details.definition: A price discontinuity between close and next open. Fabio notes gaps and often waits for them to fill before managing.

concept_details.name: HVN
concept_details.definition: High Volume Node — a thick volume area where price tends to stall or reverse. Acts as support/resistance.

concept_details.name: Imbalance
concept_details.definition: One side is aggressively pushing price to discover new value. Characterized by displacement, momentum, and directional conviction.

concept_details.name: Initial
concept_details.definition: Concept extracted from Lesson01

concept_details.name: LVN
concept_details.definition: Low Volume Node — a thinly traded area in the profile where price moves quickly. Key for entries in trend continuation.

concept_details.name: Level
concept_details.definition: Abstract root concept for any price location that matters in the market structure. Levels are derived from volume profile, market structure, and prior session data.

concept_details.name: Low_Volatility_Chart
concept_details.definition: Low volatility detected — compression or consolidation phase.

concept_details.name: Lower_Low
concept_details.definition: Price makes a new low below the previous swing low. Bearish structural development.

concept_details.name: Market
concept_details.definition: Concept extracted from Lesson01

concept_details.name: Momentum
concept_details.definition: The rate and strength of price movement. Sustained momentum confirms directional conviction.

concept_details.name: Neutral_Delta
concept_details.definition: Balanced buy/sell delta suggests equilibrium or absorption.

concept_details.name: No_Chart_Detected
concept_details.definition: No chart region identified in the video frame.

concept_details.name: Order_Flow
concept_details.definition: Abstract root concept for microstructural evidence of buyer and seller behavior at the footprint level.

concept_details.name: POC
concept_details.definition: Point of Control — the price level with the highest traded volume. Represents fair value and the strongest magnet for price.

concept_details.name: Previous_Session_High_Low
concept_details.definition: The high and low of the prior trading session. Often acts as key support/resistance and targets.

concept_details.name: Price
concept_details.definition: The current market price. The central variable that all analysis revolves around.

concept_details.name: Print
concept_details.definition: Concept extracted from Lesson01

concept_details.name: Profile
concept_details.definition: Concept extracted from Lesson01

concept_details.name: Range
concept_details.definition: Concept extracted from Lesson03

concept_details.name: Ranging_Structure
concept_details.definition: Chart structure is ranging or balanced.

concept_details.name: Retracement
concept_details.definition: A temporary price move against the prevailing trend. Synonymous with pullback in Fabio's vocabulary.

concept_details.name: Reward
concept_details.definition: Concept extracted from Lesson01

concept_details.name: Risk_to_Reward
concept_details.definition: The ratio of potential profit to initial risk. Fabio targets minimum 1:3, often 1:5 or higher on NASDAQ.

concept_details.name: Session
concept_details.definition: Concept extracted from Lesson01

concept_details.name: Setup
concept_details.definition: Abstract root concept for specific trade configurations that emerge when State + Level + Flow align.

concept_details.name: Stop_Loss
concept_details.definition: The predefined price level where a losing position is closed to limit risk. The maximum acceptable loss per trade.

concept_details.name: Target
concept_details.definition: The intended exit price for a profitable trade. Synonymous with profit target in Fabio's methodology.

concept_details.name: Trade
concept_details.definition: Concept extracted from Lesson01

concept_details.name: Trade_Management
concept_details.definition: Abstract root concept for all position and risk management activities — entries, stops, targets, sizing, and psychological control.

concept_details.name: Trend
concept_details.definition: Concept extracted from Lesson02

concept_details.name: Trending_Structure
concept_details.definition: Chart structure is clearly trending with directional bias.

concept_details.name: VAH
concept_details.definition: Value Area High — the upper boundary of the 70% volume zone. Acts as resistance in balance; breakout target in imbalance.

concept_details.name: VAL
concept_details.definition: Value Area Low — the lower boundary of the 70% volume zone. Acts as support in balance; breakdown target in imbalance.

concept_details.name: VWAP
concept_details.definition: Volume Weighted Average Price — institutional benchmark. Above VWAP = bullish bias; below = bearish bias.

concept_details.name: Visual_Balanced
concept_details.definition: Price action shows balanced, rotational market conditions.

concept_details.name: Visual_Uptrend
concept_details.definition: Price action silhouette indicates upward directional movement.

concept_details.name: Volatility
concept_details.definition: The degree of price movement. Fabio distinguishes between directional volatility (tradeable) and choppy volatility (avoid).
